lines.text: Vowels and elements, toning is not singing.
We hold one vowel and let it vibrate in the body.
Each vowel has its own place, its own quality, and its own element.
Four low notes, one for each place in the body.
Then the throat sing with me.
A grounding earth, we focus on the pelvis roots grow from your feet into the ground.
You creativity water, the middle point just below the belly.
You is the shape of a cup that holds water I energy fire.
We focus on the belly button.
Yeah Oh love and compassion air We focus on the chest The heart, the circle No beginning and no end.
A, U, I, O truth and communication.
Now the choir supports the voice.
And we are free to improvise.
The middle of the head, the third eye, the sound of the creation of the universe.
